afternoon and you'll find two people
sitting in nearly identical chairs
filling out nearly identical mortgage
applications for the same house on the
same street. Same asking price, same
down payment, same loan amount. One of
them gets up, shakes the banker's hand,
and walks out paying $2,004
a month. The other one shakes the same
banker's hand and walks out paying
$2,163
a month. They nod at each other in the
parking lot. Neither of them knows what
just hap
